_comment: Core-specific. The PPC403GCX's view of the machine, from firebeat.cpp firebeat_map (lines 774-797) and the per-family maps (1204, 1460-1464, 1563, 1656-1659, 1872-1875). Read by mame_capture.py, write_timing.py and the trace scripts. Addresses are hex strings, inclusive, 31-bit physical. GCU VRAM is not CPU-addressable and not a memory share in MAME: reference VRAM comes from a MAME savestate (k057714.cpp:43), not from a capture region. workram is 32 MB; a capture of it is slow in Lua, narrow it to the frames of interest once the game's layout is known.

trace._comment: The PPC has no IPL; ipl reads MSR bit 15 (EE, external interrupts enabled). vectors is the reset vector word; the exception table lives at EVPR, set by the BIOS.

inputs._comment: ppp names; popn has no Start (nine buttons), bm3 uses 'P1 Start'. Run scripts/mame/ports.lua per set for the exact field names.
